title: Fun Ride!
text: Our guide was quite informative and knowledgeable. He made it easy to follow him on the bikes. A great to get oriented into a beautiful city.
author: Julia_J

title: Something different again!
text: Something different again, on a bike through Barcelona!! Had a great tour, beautiful weather, with the guide Thomas, who apparently knew a lot, also of history, with humor, which made it very interesting, very friendly man. Definitely recommended!!
author: mariannevA519OE

title: Without a guide through the...
text:
Walking through the Sagrada without a guide is certainly exciting too! But having the complexity of the building explained down to many details is a highlight!
Thumbs up! Definitely plan this into your visit to Barcelona…
author: Dietmar_S

title: E-bike tour of Barcelona
text: We arrived a little early and were able to join the group before ours, which was great. Our tour guide was Peter and he was very knowledgeable about Barcelona. The bike tour was easy enough for most riders, even if you have had no previous experience with an e-bike. Definitely a great way to see many tourist spots in Barcelona and an overview of the city. The entire tour was slightly over 2 hours.
author: Vacation36895832733

title: Good intro to the city
text: Kieran was a well versed tour guide who helped us see some major sites while also getting a good initial feel for the city. Great way to start off trip to Barcelona!
author: Christopher_H

title: Beautiful bicycle ride around Barrio Gotico
text: It was a súper nice ride and Maria A was a great and friendly tour guide! It included spots highlights I wanted to see! :-)
author: Juan_S

title: Ideal activity for cruise passengers
text: Excellent way to visit Barcelona's main attractions in a few hours! Perfect for cruise passengers.
author: Evelyne_B

title: Best way to see the city!
text: This was the perfect way to see the city! Our guide Serguy was incredibly knowledgeable and helpful, and the 2 1/2 hour tour was the perfect length! Also, Barcelona is a bike friendly city, so we felt safe and comfortable on the bikes at all times. I highly recommend this tour!
author: Jennifer_M

title: Nice easy ride
text: Great views, iconic Barcelona sites. Ride mostly through side streets so not so many cars to worry about.
author: kswinkeymirowski

title: Great for active teenagers
text: Great way to see the city. More active and intimate than a city bus tour, but similar level of "overview". I went with my 12 year old son, and the bike tour was fun for both of us. If we wanted more in depth exploration, we might have chosen something else, but we basically wanted to just scope out the city, and this let us do that. Barcelona is such a bike friendly city, I felt completely safe and really enjoyed the feeling of sailing around. The e-Bike is definitely the way to go with kids or as a not usual biker.
